line-segment.checked: Mouse and touch drag directly on the chart select a range. Clear removes it.
line-segment.remaining: Compare selection guides and exact date fixtures.

area-selection.checked: Mouse and touch drag directly on the chart select a range and show its dates.
area-selection.remaining: Compare the selected fill and hover treatment.

line-date-highlights-brush.checked: At mobile width, weekend shading is hidden when dates are dense and appears after zooming in. The launch marker stays on its original date.
line-date-highlights-brush.remaining: Compare precise density thresholds and band styling.

line-zoom.checked: Ctrl-wheel and Cmd-wheel zoom the chart. Double-click resets the range.
line-zoom.remaining: Compare zoom sensitivity, pan easing, and limits.

bar-depth.checked: Pause pulse and Resume pulse control the bar highlight animation.
bar-depth.remaining: Compare depth, material styling, and pulse timing.

area-loading.checked: Pulse, Sweep, and Loaded switch the placeholder and data states.
area-loading.remaining: Compare the exact skeleton and reveal animation.

live-line-loading.checked: Reconnect shows the skeleton before restoring the live chart.
live-line-loading.remaining: Compare the connection timing and skeleton styling.

line-brush.checked: The overview window pans and resizes. Its handles respond to the keyboard, and Escape restores the range after a drag.
line-brush.remaining: Compare overview styling and the timing of axis rescaling.

line-linked-brush.checked: One overview controls both detail charts. The detail charts share a tooltip date.
line-linked-brush.remaining: Compare animation timing and date-label behavior during continuous drag.

line-synced.checked: Requests, latency, and errors share the same tooltip date.
line-synced.remaining: Compare the crosshair animation and panel spacing.

line-band-range.checked: The temperature range shows both boundaries. The tooltip gives the low and high in degrees Celsius.
line-band-range.remaining: Compare band styling and chart scale with the reference data.

line-band-bollinger.checked: The band appears after the nine-point warm-up.
line-band-bollinger.remaining: Compare the remaining band styling and the exact fixture series.

line-large-data.checked: The Canvas chart displays minute-sampled p50 and p95 series. It starts at 50,000 points and switches to 10,000 or 100,000. The tooltip reports both raw values.
line-large-data.remaining: The nearest displayed minute can be affected by decimation. Compare lookup behavior and rendering performance at the largest setting.

gauge-fixed.checked: Three gauges retain 160 × 160 pixel dimensions on desktop and mobile.
gauge-fixed.remaining: Compare label placement and exact arc treatment.

gauge-interactive.checked: The chart opens on Q3. Selecting Q2 sweeps the gauge and animates the revenue to $1.41 million.
gauge-interactive.remaining: Compare the sweep and number animation timing.

gauge-dial.checked: Next reading cycles through all six readings and returns to the first.
gauge-dial.remaining: Compare the dial, ruler ticks, and needle appearance.

gauge-live-load.checked: The gauge updates every 1.8 seconds. The Now, Average, and Peak readouts update with the readings.
gauge-live-load.remaining: Compare the later reading sequence and zone transitions.

sunburst-default.checked: Arrow keys inspect segments, Enter drills into a branch, and Escape moves back up. Focus remains in the chart.
sunburst-default.remaining: Compare branch geometry and the drill animation at each depth.

sunburst-breadcrumb.checked: Breadcrumb buttons jump back to the selected ancestor after drill-down.
sunburst-breadcrumb.remaining: Compare breadcrumb labels and transitions with the source hierarchy.

sunburst-legend.checked: The legend displays shares, highlights the matching branch on hover, and drills into it on click.
sunburst-legend.remaining: Compare branch order, legend styling, and touch behavior.

pie-center-custom.checked: Caller-supplied center content receives the focused segment, value, total, and share.
pie-center-custom.remaining: Compare the built-in typography and digit animation.

ring-center-custom.checked: Caller-supplied center content receives the active ring's target and attainment fraction. The idle state reports the aggregate.
ring-center-custom.remaining: Compare built-in center styling and transitions.

pie-hover-effects.checked: Translate, Grow, and None are available. None leaves slices stationary and undimmed.
pie-hover-effects.remaining: Compare the translate and grow motion curves.

radial-default.checked: The chart has 96 quarter-hour positions, three statuses, and interactive legend isolation. Keyboard and pointer input inspect the current and previous day.
radial-default.remaining: Compare exact data, dot pattern, and transitions.

radial-line.checked: A dashed previous-day line and a current-day line share 96 quarter-hour positions. The current-day line stops at 14:30.
radial-line.remaining: Compare the exact time-series fixture and curve.

radial-bar-clock.checked: Rounded stacked bars and a rotating cursor identify the selected quarter hour. Keyboard focus wraps across midnight.
radial-bar-clock.remaining: Compare the exact scrubber spring and bar styling.

radial-area-clock.checked: Three areas sweep in and show their edge markers at the selected quarter hour. Keyboard focus wraps across midnight.
radial-area-clock.remaining: Compare the exact sweep and area geometry.

choropleth-default.checked: Wheel and pinch zoom, pointer drag, keyboard country selection, and reset work.
choropleth-default.remaining: Compare projection, camera inertia, and geographic labels.

choropleth-click-to-zoom.checked: An office click or keyboard activation flies to the target. Clicking the target again or clicking the sea resets the view, as does Escape.

choropleth-pointer-camera.checked: The map tilts with the pointer while its dot backdrop remains stationary. Keyboard activation can fly to and return from a country.
choropleth-pointer-camera.remaining: The local camera uses an affine transform. Compare perspective with the reference.

choropleth-dot-grid.checked: Zooming grows the land dots and fades the ocean dots. Reset restores the full world lattice.
choropleth-dot-grid.remaining: Compare lattice density and exact office coordinates.

heatmap-active-scale.checked: The active cell and corresponding legend swatch grow to 110%, while other swatches fade.
heatmap-active-scale.remaining: Compare transition timing and intensity colors.

heatmap-dots.checked: Inactive dots shrink and fade during inspection.
heatmap-dots.remaining: Compare dot spacing and tooltip treatment.

heatmap-loading.checked: Showing the data triggers a delayed, per-cell reveal wave.
heatmap-loading.remaining: Compare the delay and easing of the reveal.

scatter-default.checked: The tooltip groups both series for a week, and unrelated marks blur during inspection.
scatter-default.remaining: Compare precise tooltip and blur treatment with the reference fixture.

scatter-rings.checked: The preview shows 21 daily points with wider rings and a stronger hover fade.
scatter-rings.remaining: Compare point spacing and marker geometry.

scatter-jitter.checked: The preview shows 522 points in 12 month columns and reports the nearest point to the pointer.
scatter-jitter.remaining: Compare the exact jitter distribution and hit regions.

scatter-outline.checked: The axes display dates and percentages.
scatter-outline.remaining: Compare ring styling and axis label spacing.

scatter-solid.checked: The axes display daily samples and milliseconds.
scatter-solid.remaining: Compare value scale and hover styling.

histogram-default.checked: The histogram uses 20-millisecond bins and labels the intervals in the tooltip.
histogram-default.remaining: Compare the exact sample distribution and bar styling.

histogram-overlay.checked: Both distributions share 50-millisecond bins. Hovering or focusing a median legend item fades the other distribution.
histogram-overlay.remaining: Compare exact fixture medians and opacity transitions.

histogram-stacked.checked: The stacked bins advance in two-minute intervals, ending at the 40-minute domain limit.
histogram-stacked.remaining: Compare bin heights and exact fixture distribution.

ecdf-default.checked: The chart labels the p50 and p90 guides.
ecdf-default.remaining: Compare exact quantile values and guide styles.

ecdf-compare.checked: Both curves share the pointer or keyboard threshold and show aligned dots and decimal percentages.
ecdf-compare.remaining: Compare focus styling and movement across plateaus.

ecdf-loading.checked: Toggling from the loading staircase reveals the distribution from left to right.
ecdf-loading.remaining: Compare the reveal duration and placeholder styling.

tooltip-indicator.checked: The Line, Thin, Medium, and Thick controls switch the cursor geometry. Medium is selected on entry.
tooltip-indicator.remaining: Compare exact cursor color, stroke treatment, and tooltip positioning across themes.

tooltip-motion.checked: Eased, Matched, and Instant switch how the panel follows the pointer. Instant disables the transition.
tooltip-motion.remaining: Compare the spring timing and how the panel follows the cursor on rapid motion.

tooltip-pinned.checked: The pinned view reveals the day's revenue by channel. Enter and Space pin the selected day, and Escape clears the pin inside the preview.
tooltip-pinned.remaining: Compare pinned-panel layout, number animation, and touch interactions.

tooltip-horizontal-crosshair.checked: Moving the pointer vertically moves the price readout even when the selected date stays the same.
tooltip-horizontal-crosshair.remaining: Compare price formatting and tick-label fading at both edges of the axis.

tooltip-custom-indicator.checked: A bar below the active month marks the selection. The chart displays a revenue tooltip and omits the vertical cursor line.
tooltip-custom-indicator.remaining: Compare indicator motion and placement at narrow widths.
